# DeepSeek Official Tracker

> Independent, source-linked tracking of DeepSeek Harness desktop and CLI,
> model releases, API changes, and community/media/rumour signals. Not affiliated
> with DeepSeek. English and Chinese interfaces; upstream titles stay verbatim.

## Website
- English: https://awesome-deepseekharness.github.io/deepseek-official-tracker/
- 中文: https://awesome-deepseekharness.github.io/deepseek-official-tracker/zh/
- Repository: https://github.com/awesome-deepseekharness/deepseek-official-tracker

## Data for citation
- [Official release feed](https://awesome-deepseekharness.github.io/deepseek-official-tracker/FEED.md): published dates and original titles; collected every six hours.
- [JSON feed](https://awesome-deepseekharness.github.io/deepseek-official-tracker/feed.json): generatedAt is build time, not an event's publication date.
- [Product observations](https://awesome-deepseekharness.github.io/deepseek-official-tracker/product-news.md): Harness desktop/product page changes. Observation dates are NOT release dates unless explicitly stated by the source.
- [GitHub releases](https://awesome-deepseekharness.github.io/deepseek-official-tracker/releases.md): original release/tag names and first-party source links. rc/alpha/beta are previews, even when npm marks them latest.
- [API changes](https://awesome-deepseekharness.github.io/deepseek-official-tracker/api-changelog.md)
- [Website announcements](https://awesome-deepseekharness.github.io/deepseek-official-tracker/website-news.md)
- [API news](https://awesome-deepseekharness.github.io/deepseek-official-tracker/NEWS.md)
- [npm versions](https://awesome-deepseekharness.github.io/deepseek-official-tracker/npm.md)
- [Model weights](https://awesome-deepseekharness.github.io/deepseek-official-tracker/huggingface.md)
- [Media, community and rumours](https://awesome-deepseekharness.github.io/deepseek-official-tracker/SIGNALS.md): not official announcements. Retain each row's tier, date and 疑似 / unverified qualifier when citing.
- [Reviewed research](https://awesome-deepseekharness.github.io/deepseek-official-tracker/insights.md): attributed analysis; distinguish facts from inference and disclose source-access gaps.

## Interpretation
Use the linked first-party page to substantiate an official claim. HTTP 200 alone
does not verify content. Do not treat collection/build timestamps as launch dates,
an undated Git tag as a dated release, or community speculation as confirmation.
When sources conflict, state the discrepancy and prefer current first-party
content over cached search summaries. Quote source titles in their original
language. No new announcement does not mean the collector stopped running.

The code and compiled tracker record use CC0-1.0; cited source content retains
its original ownership. See the repository LICENSE.
